title: Omnichannel Reports: Which Report Answers Which Question | CrestApps for Orchard Core
description:
Your own to-do list shows only your own work. The omnichannel reports in CrestApps for Orchard Core show how much work is open, who is behind, which campaign works and how leads become deals, from the first activity to the closed opportunity.

In this video:
• Where the reports are, their filters and the permission they need
• Volume and completion: Activity summary, Campaign performance, Disposition breakdown
• Backlog and age: Activity backlog, Activity aging, Overdue workload by user
• Workload grouped by source, channel, kind, assignment, urgency and attempts
• People: assigned user, completion time, daily productivity and creators
• Campaign mixes, customer workload and address usage
• Dialer call detail and AI handoff and containment
• Lead funnel, lead conversion and the opportunity pipeline
• The omnichannel and messaging data sets of the Report Builder
• Use cases
